records.rationale: Native fw_devlink/fwnode graph implementation supersedes the historical direct-device-link algorithm and of_devlink parameter. Native binding table covers clocks/interconnects/regulators plus later suppliers, optional/strict flags and reference cleanup. Preserve native x86 early return in of_fwnode_add_links, current signatures, cycle handling and atomic flags. OF property file is exactly LTS except separately reviewed u8 helper; parameters.rst is native and the only txt delta is separately reviewed DPM watchdog documentation. No old of_devlink path is restored.

records.rationale: Omit the paired physical Bay Trail DTS/INT3401 enumeration redesign: SDK disables INTEL_SOC_DTS_THERMAL. 8c395ddaf3b7 removes the accidentally retained Kconfig half, restoring entire native Kconfig alongside already-native ACPI handler. This preserves coherent native IRQ enumeration rather than mixing the two implementations; no physical thermal capability is enabled and no native security fix is removed.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json

records.rationale: Omit lifetime/export conversion of timer-of helpers for loadable physical SoC timer drivers. SDK has no CONFIG_TIMER_OF selection; drivers/clocksource/Makefile gates timer-of.o on it. Examined local callers are physical ARM/SoC timers. Keep both timer-of files entirely native, with init section lifetimes and native clock cleanup; no new platform timer is introduced. This does not omit generic OF module source helpers selected separately.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
SECURITY.md: Native interface and timer review

records.rationale: Complete the already-declared generic of_property_read_u8_index source API for configured OF and vendor modules in 0e1e2683ed4e. Adapt ACK to compare index against validated property length before indexing; original (index+1) wraps at U32_MAX and can bypass minimum-size checking. Preserve native property errors and leave output unchanged on failure. No exact SDK caller was established; conservative configured source-interface retention, not evidence of runtime need. Extracted-code sanitizer tests cover bounds/errors and reject original overflow; all other property.c code remains native.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
SECURITY.md: Native interface and timer review

records.rationale: Complete declared/exported generic root match/data helpers in 0e1e2683ed4e using exact ACK function bodies atop native base.c. Hold and release the root node reference; returned data belongs to caller match table, not the released node. CONFIG_OF=n stubs/declarations remain. Retain for configured OF/module source compatibility while exact SDK use remains unknown; no additional DT platform enabled. Extracted-function reference tests pass, not a live device-tree test.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
SECURITY.md: Native interface and timer review

records.rationale: The race fix is already native LTS: work_in_progress is an independent bool, preventing shared-bitfield RMW corruption during parallel suspend. Whole pm.h differs only by three blank lines. Preserve native representation and omit both generated STG inventories, which describe historical layout/type IDs rather than executable behavior. Do not classify the actual concurrency fix as KMI-only or restore the unsafe bitfield.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
SECURITY.md: Native interface and timer review

records.rationale: Omit ARM/ARM64-only kernel NEON guard API migration; Makefile selects these two implementations only with KERNEL_MODE_NEON, absent in SDK x86 configuration, whose raid6 selection uses x86 SSE/AVX code. Keep both files byte-identical to native LTS and preserve native arithmetic/NEON bracketing. No claim of an upstream equivalent and no other-architecture build verified.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
SECURITY.md: Native interface and timer review

records.rationale: Retain shared V4L2 capacity increase from 256 to 512 in 3188544c95fb. It affects the common video/subdevice registry, not only one physical camera. All bitmap/array/search/chrdev bounds use same constant, and native locking/lifetime code is unchanged; SDK disables fixed minor ranges. This preserves configured Android driver capacity with extra static storage and possible nodes. Exact SDK requirement above 256 is unconfirmed; conservative common-interface compatibility rather than an assertion of a found consumer.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
SECURITY.md: Native interface and timer review

records.rationale: Retain stream API enablement in 3188544c95fb: exact candidate delta atop native subdev code. This lifts the LTS experimental hard gate and expands reachable ioctl behavior; it is a compatibility tradeoff, not a security fix. Native driver stream flag, client capability mask, readonly checks, stream/pad/type/route bounds and reserved-field clearing remain. Configured V4L2_SUBDEV_API supports vendor source interfaces; exact SDK multistream use is unconfirmed. No physical camera or driver capability is added, and runtime ioctl behavior is unverified.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json

records.rationale: Adapt timer arithmetic in b707484227a8 because the existing SDK workflow packages both 32-bit and 64-bit userspace tests. Widen multiplication before evaluation and 5/10-second constants. Keep native b-minus-a timespec helpers and caller order; original ACK common helpers reverse convention without updating nsleep-lat calls, so helpers.h and its BUILD dependency are omitted. Preserve prior LONG_MIN/MAX guards and native timekeeping fixes. Extracted signed ILP32 arithmetic covers 441 cases for each helper with old-overflow negative control; no timer, clock-change or suspend test executed.
evidence: evidence/native-interface-tail-review.json
